subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should maintainers sponsor live Feishu proof or adopt one of the known narrow candidate fixes before allowing another repair attempt for this issue?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but multiple exact-fix PRs have already closed unmerged because source-only proof was not enough for this Feishu delivery behavior.

options.title: Sponsor proof and adopt a narrow fix
options.body: Use a live Feishu setup or explicit proof override to validate the known fix shape, then land a narrow plugin-boundary repair.

options.title: Accept source-only repair
options.body: Allow a new focused PR with unit coverage despite the lack of live Feishu proof, accepting the delivery-risk uncertainty.

options.title: Keep parked
options.body: Leave the issue open with no new fix PR until a reporter or maintainer can provide live Feishu proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor proof and adopt a narrow fix
recommendation.body: Use a live Feishu setup or explicit proof override to validate the known fix shape, then land a narrow plugin-boundary repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Most central history for both the regression-adjacent message-tool change and the later native card payload support is from vincentkoc.
